lead: A checkbox, with its behaviour from Base UI's Checkbox. A `<label>` wraps the control and its text; the states sit on the control, and theme styles use `:has()` to restyle the whole label. The examples follow the Checkbox and CheckboxGroup pages of the HeroUI docs.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `outline` matches HeroUI v3's primary, `filled` its secondary.

select-all.title: Select All
select-all.description: The parent uses `indeterminate` for a partial selection; you keep the selected set yourself.

in-field.title: In a Field
in-field.description: Inside a [Field](/field), the invalid state comes from the Field's validation.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `checkbox.css`. The check mark and the dash are two SVGs in the component; which one shows and how it animates is up to the theme style.
styling.slot: Structure hooks. `checkbox` is the outer `<label>`, `checkbox-control` the actual control
styling.states: State hooks, written on `checkbox-control` and `checkbox-indicator`; theme styles read them with `:has()` to restyle the whole label (dimming it when disabled, say)
